title: Harvey Weinstein's rape charge to be dropped by New York prosecutors, bringing closure to #MeToo case
summary: The charge stemmed from allegations by hairstylist and actor Jessica Mann, who accused Weinstein of raping her in a Manhattan hotel room in 2013.
